title: Use of Default Credentials
description: One or more systems, applications, or devices retain vendor-supplied default usernames and passwords. These credentials are publicly documented and trivially discoverable, allowing any attacker to authenticate and gain access, frequently with administrative privileges.
businessImpact: Critical --- default credentials provide immediate, often privileged, access to affected systems, enabling data compromise, configuration changes, and lateral movement.
remediation:
- Change all default credentials to strong, unique values before deployment.
- Maintain an inventory of devices/applications and verify default accounts are disabled or renamed.
- Enforce a credential-hardening checklist in provisioning and build processes.
- Where supported, require a forced password change on first login.
